finding.finding: The supplied snapshot supports restored grid power at Divulapitiya (S18), while equipment condition remains unknown. Its service V18 is the only approved critical service (weight 5); all other services have approved weight 1. No operational outage is established by the supplied reports, so there is no evidence-based repair or generator action to defer. Do not infer equipment status from the rumor or treat the customer complaint or planned Kadawatha outage as verified asset faults.

No actions are scheduled, so there are no travel or work-time arithmetic checks or evidence-based safety holds to assess. The forecast conservatively treats unknown S18 equipment as unavailable and applies its approved service weight of 5; the other services retain weight 1.
